hyperedges.label: File Upload → Validation → AI Parse → Transaction Write Pipeline
Cross-Platform Onboarding: Web Wizard + Mobile Screen + API
CI/CD: Change Detection → Conditional Staging → Production Approval Gate

nodes.label: File Processing Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Files are processed asynchronously via next/server after() to avoid blocking the HTTP response. Status polling every 3s allows the client to track progress without websockets. Magic-byte validation is preferred over MIME-type alone because MIME can be spoofed.

nodes.label: Magic-Byte File Validation
nodes.rationale: MIME type alone is not trusted; magic bytes (PDF=%PDF, JPEG=FFD8FF, PNG=89504E47, WebP=RIFF, CSV=UTF-8 text) are verified before storage to prevent file type spoofing attacks.

nodes.label: AI Sanitizer (lib/ai/sanitize.ts)
nodes.rationale: Strips 17 prompt injection patterns and caps cells at 500 chars to prevent AI prompt injection attacks before data is sent to the AI model.

nodes.label: Gemma 4 AI Model
nodes.rationale: Gemma 4 is multimodal (supports JPEG/PNG/WebP/HEIC images) making it suitable for receipt parsing. It does not support PDF via Ollama cloud.

nodes.label: ensureCategories() Lazy Seed
nodes.rationale: Lazy seeding of system categories on first call avoids needing a separate CLI seed command, reducing deployment complexity.

nodes.label: MinIO Object Storage (local dev)
nodes.rationale: MinIO is used locally to emulate Google Cloud Storage, allowing local development without cloud credentials.

nodes.label: UI Design System
nodes.rationale: Dark slate-950 sidebar with emerald-600 accent. Table cards must not use overflow-hidden as it clips dropdown menus like CategoryPicker.

nodes.label: Dashboard Analytics
nodes.rationale: Dashboard shows money in/out/net for current month only, recent 6 transactions, and top 5 merchants by debit total. All amounts use household defaultCurrency via Intl.NumberFormat.

nodes.label: Security Layer (SuperSecGuy)
nodes.rationale: Security hardening: magic-byte validation, prompt injection sanitization, rate limiting (10 uploads/min), generic error messages (no stack traces), zod input validation, IDOR protection via householdId membership checks.

nodes.label: IDOR Protection Pattern
nodes.rationale: All file and transaction access is verified against caller's household membership to prevent Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) attacks.

nodes.label: Neon PostgreSQL (DATABASE_URL / DIRECT_URL)
nodes.rationale: Neon uses pgbouncer pooled URL at runtime and a direct URL for migrations only. Both must be set to avoid migration lock conflicts.

nodes.label: Vercel Deployment Platform
nodes.rationale: Vercel is used for both landing and web app deployments. CLI pull/build/deploy pattern allows prebuilt deployment artifacts.

nodes.label: EAS (Expo Application Services) Build/Update
nodes.rationale: EAS differentiates native (full APK rebuild) from JS-only changes (OTA update) to reduce build time.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md (Next.js Agent Rules)
nodes.rationale: Warns AI agents that this Next.js version has breaking changes from training data; instructs reading node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code.

nodes.label: Brand Palette: White Letterform on Green Background
nodes.norm_label: brand palette: white letterform on green background

nodes.label: Splash Screen Logo (Concentric Circles Blueprint)
nodes.description: White background with a light gray grid pattern and three concentric circles — geometric/blueprint aesthetic. Used as the Expo splash screen logo across all Android drawable density buckets (hdpi, mdpi, xhdpi, xxhdpi, xxxhdpi).

nodes.label: App Launcher Icon (Squircle — Emerald E)
nodes.description: Rounded-rectangle (squircle) Android launcher icon. Emerald green (#1A9C6E-range) background with a bold white serif/sans 'E' lettermark centered. Present across mipmap-hdpi, mdpi, xhdpi, xxhdpi, xxxhdpi density buckets.

nodes.label: App Launcher Icon Round (Circle — Emerald E)
nodes.description: Circular crop variant of the Android launcher icon. Same emerald green background and white 'E' lettermark as ic_launcher, but rendered in a circle as required by Android for round-icon-capable launchers. Present across all mipmap density buckets.
nodes.norm_label: app launcher icon round (circle — emerald e)

nodes.label: Adaptive Icon Foreground Layer (White E on Transparent)
nodes.description: Foreground layer for Android adaptive icons (API 26+). White 'E' lettermark on a fully transparent background. Composited over a separate background layer by the Android launcher at runtime. Present across all mipmap density buckets.
nodes.norm_label: adaptive icon foreground layer (white e on transparent)

nodes.label: Android Drawable Density Buckets (hdpi/mdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi)
nodes.description: Android resource system density qualifier directories. Each stores the same logical asset at increasing pixel densities (mdpi=1x, hdpi=1.5x, xhdpi=2x, xxhdpi=3x, xxxhdpi=4x) so the OS picks the best fit for the device screen.

nodes.label: Android Mipmap Density Buckets (hdpi/mdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi)
nodes.description: Android mipmap resource directories specifically for launcher icons. Unlike drawable, mipmap folders are never stripped during APK splits, ensuring icons remain crisp on all launchers regardless of target density configuration.

nodes.label: Expensable Brand Lettermark — Emerald 'E'
nodes.description: Core brand identity element shared across the Expensable mobile app icons: a bold white 'E' lettermark on an emerald green background. Consistent with the web UI design system's emerald-600 accent color.

nodes.label: Android Launcher Icon (ic_launcher)
nodes.description: Standard Android adaptive launcher icon. Square with rounded corners. White background with light-blue two-tone X/cross logomark (Expensable brand mark). Appears across mipmap-hdpi, mipmap-mdpi, mipmap-xhdpi, mipmap-xxhdpi, mipmap-xxxhdpi density buckets.

nodes.label: Android Round Launcher Icon (ic_launcher_round)
nodes.description: Circular variant of the Android adaptive launcher icon. White circle background with the same light-blue X/cross logomark centred. Used on launchers that enforce circular icon shapes. Appears across all mipmap density buckets.

nodes.label: Android Launcher Icon Foreground Layer (ic_launcher_foreground)
nodes.description: Foreground layer for Android adaptive icons. Transparent background with the light-blue X/cross logomark and faint grid guidelines, sized with safe-zone padding as required by the adaptive icon spec. Combined with a background layer at runtime. Appears across mipmap-hdpi, mipmap-mdpi, mipmap-xhdpi, mipmap-xxhdpi, mipmap-xxxhdpi.

nodes.label: Android Portrait Splash Screen
nodes.description: Portrait-orientation splash screen shown on Android while the app initialises. Solid white background with the Expensable light-blue X/cross logomark centred. Tall aspect ratio (~9:16 region). Resolution variants: drawable-port-hdpi, drawable-port-mdpi, drawable-port-xhdpi, drawable-port-xxhdpi, drawable-port-xxxhdpi.

nodes.label: Android Landscape Splash Screen
nodes.description: Landscape-orientation splash screen shown on Android while the app initialises. Solid white background with the Expensable light-blue X/cross logomark centred. Wide aspect ratio (~16:9 region). Resolution variants: drawable-land-hdpi, drawable-land-mdpi, drawable-land-xhdpi, drawable-land-xxhdpi, drawable-land-xxxhdpi.

nodes.label: Expensable Brand Logomark (X/Cross)
nodes.description: The shared visual identity element used across all Android launcher and splash assets: a two-tone light-blue diagonal X / cross shape on a white or transparent background. Consistent with the Expensable brand.

nodes.label: Android Resource Directory (apps/web/android)
nodes.description: Android native resource tree nested inside apps/web. Contains mipmap-* launcher icon buckets and drawable-land-*/drawable-port-* splash screen buckets across five density qualifiers (mdpi, hdpi, xhdpi, xxhdpi, xxxhdpi).
